profile.summary_th: A digital illustration of a fantastical creature with a crystalline and geometric design.
preserve_constraints: The camera is positioned directly in front of the character, looking at it from its chest to its tail.
The creature's head is visible with two eyes and a prominent crest on top.
The torso extends from the base of the neck down to the midsection, showing a central gem-like ornament.
The arms are attached to the upper body and extend outwards from the shoulders.
The legs are positioned beneath the creature's feet, extending downwards from the hips.
The chest ornament is a large, triangular blue crystal embedded in the center of the torso.
hidden_parts: There is no visible area hidden from this camera view. The entire body and tail are fully shown.
No parts of the creature's anatomy are obscured by other elements or shadows in this image.
